title: Present Project directory selection and detail-header truth

requirements.invariant: Project browsing remains usable from synchronized local data and exposes incomplete readiness. Directory core rows carry stable Project identity, current Project display name, stable Client relationship and current Client display name. Active/Archived selection uses Project lifecycle only. Projection preserves exact upstream order and invents no target sorting or search rule.

Project.clientId is the relationship identity. Client display name is current display only and cannot authorize, identify, filter or merge Projects. Duplicate Project or Client names remain distinct by stable identity.

Directory absence is authoritative only when the source is ready, complete and exhaustive. Partial, stale, incomplete or nonexhaustive evidence never proves an empty segment. Represented partial/stale rows remain explicitly usable as local evidence without granting authorization.

Selection binds Account, segment, exact ordered projected rows and their Project/Client identity, names and lifecycles, source query fingerprint, source/visible row counts, completeness, quality, local data version and as-of time. Restart is canonical; changed or rebound evidence cannot replay as unchanged. The only request-producing call is ProjectBrowsingSelection.detailRequest(validating: currentSnapshot), which rejects a snapshot/evidence mismatch before deriving the verified ProjectCoreDetailsRequest and never returns a route or authorization claim.

The detail header consumes the verified ProjectCoreDetailsUpdate and preserves exact local truth. Found ready/partial/stale evidence shows current Project and Client text with readiness; only ready-complete empty is authoritative absence; unavailable is non-enumerating; retryable/required-update cached evidence remains stale and failures stay distinct.

Exactly four target-only Swift leaf paths implement and test provider-free presentation while Firebase remains unchanged. Full Project cards, sorting/search, tabs/children, routes, actions, authorization, persistence, app/MCP, provider/schema/RLS/Sync, migration and production behavior do not advance.

Archiving a Client hides it from new-Project selection without deleting its Projects or history. Existing Projects continue to resolve the exact Client identity and current display evidence; an active Project remains in the active Project segment when its Client is archived.

items: ProjectDirectorySegment is exactly active or archived. ProjectDirectoryCoreRow exposes stable Project ID/name, stable Client ID/current name and Project/Client lifecycle; it is not a complete Project Card.

ProjectDirectoryPresentationProjector accepts only a validated ProjectListSnapshot, filters strictly by Project lifecycle, preserves upstream order, reports source quality/completeness/exhaustiveness and computes a canonical evidence fingerprint over every named source and projected field.

ProjectBrowsingSelection can be created only for an exact represented row in the projected segment and binds that row to the presentation evidence fingerprint. Its only request-producing call is detailRequest(validating: currentSnapshot); it rejects changed evidence before deriving only ProjectCoreDetailsRequest for the same Account/Project.

ProjectDetailHeaderPresentationProjector consumes request-validated ProjectCoreDetailsUpdate and exposes exact Project/Client text, readiness, authoritative absence and stable failure without converting unavailable or incomplete evidence into not-found truth.

Partial and stale represented rows remain visible with their exact quality; empty evidence is authoritative only when ready, complete and exhaustive.

items: Implementation remains inside provider-free LedgerTargetCore and tests and cannot link or modify either application project.
The slice cannot sort/search Projects, render hero/budget cards, define tabs/children, navigate, mutate, authorize, persist, deploy, release or cut over.
O-023/O-024/O-025 and A-003/A-004/A-007/A-015/A-016 remain outside the boundary.

verification.expected: Active/Archived projection filters strictly by Project lifecycle and preserves exact upstream order. An active Project with archived Client stays active with current Client text; an archived Project stays archived; duplicate names remain distinct by stable Project ID. Rows omit hero, budget, action, route and authorization state.

An empty segment is authoritative only from ready, complete, source-exhaustive evidence. Ready-nonexhaustive, ready-incomplete, partial-empty and stale-empty remain incomplete; partial/stale represented rows remain usable with exact quality and no false absence.

Canonical restart binds Account, segment, ordered rows and exact Project/Client identity/name/lifecycle, source query fingerprint, source and visible counts, completeness, quality, LocalDataVersion and asOf. Independently changed/reordered/removed fields, nonfinite time, malformed or missing canonical keys and fingerprint tamper fail closed.

Selection rejects unprojected ID, opposite-segment Project, wrong Account and rebound/changed evidence. Same-name rows select exact stable identity. ProjectBrowsingSelection.detailRequest(validating: currentSnapshot) rejects any current-snapshot/evidence mismatch before returning only the exact verified ProjectCoreDetailsRequest and no route, Principal or authorization evidence.

Request-validated waiting states show no titles; found ready/partial/stale evidence shows exact local Project/Client text and readiness; ready-complete empty alone is authoritative absence. Archived Project and active Project with archived Client remain found. Partial/stale/incomplete empty never becomes absence.

Unavailable is non-enumerating with no cached titles. Retryable and requiredUpdate stay distinct; valid cached rows display only as stale evidence and no-cache failures are blocked. Mismatched request/cache/update and malformed evidence fail closed. One projected-row selection derives the exact detail request only while validating against the same current snapshot, then produces the matching detail header; changed directory evidence is rejected before request derivation.

verification.owner: pull-request CI Isolated target environment job
verification.expected: The exact implementation commit passes traceability, source/provider isolation, generated contracts, complete tests, repeatable project generation, both staging builds and clean artifacts while the worker candidate changes only the four allowlisted leaf paths.

notes: Ready only; four comment scaffolds contain no executable behavior. The first scout recommendation, CreateSpaceFromTemplate, was withdrawn because it contradicted a recorded authority rejection and O-026 plus name/identity/atomicity/provenance/customization semantics remain unresolved. Independent Project-browsing preflight removed noncanonical sorting, fixed tabs and route construction and corrected full-card naming, Client-lifecycle filtering, nonexhaustive-empty truth and evidence binding. Actual-ready-diff review then caught a P1 unrelated D-023 citation, a P1 missing exact Client-lifecycle authority and a P2 stale-selection API ambiguity; the corrected contract uses D-006 only for identity, cites Client lifecycle directly and requires current-snapshot validation before request derivation. This frozen outcome preserves upstream order and covers only directory core rows, evidence-bound selection, exact detail-request derivation and detail-header truth.
